name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES_NUM_VAL
description: The Auth Entities Number Value table contains information that describes, for a specific entity in the Auth Entities table, the value of the contact number type (e.g. Phone or Fax) in the matching related line.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number of the associated entity in the auth bundle. Together with AUTH_BUNDLE_ID, this forms the foreign key to the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple entity contact values associated with the auth bundle and the auth entitty from the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: ENTITY_CNTCT_VALUE
columns.description: The contact value for the corresponding contact type. For example, if the type was phone, this would be a phone number.
